task: Dragging a group of cards jumps back

steps.title: Reproduce
steps.hypothesis: The jump happens with any two selected cards
steps.method: Select two cards and drag them in a browser check

runs.what: Drag two selected cards, ten times

steps.result: Held: the group jumps back every time

steps.title: Narrow it down
steps.method: Log which cards the press picks up

runs.what: Log the picked cards on press

steps.result: Held: the press starts with no cards picked

steps.title: Find the cause
steps.hypothesis: The press handler ignores the page's selection
steps.method: Read the press handler and what it is given
steps.result: Held: it starts from an empty list, never the selection

steps.title: Fix
steps.hypothesis: Starting the press from the selection keeps the group together
steps.method: Change the handler, then run step 1's check again

runs.what: Start the press from the page's selection
Drag two selected cards, twenty times
Unit tests: a press keeps what was selected
